name: HSBC Holdings
title: 3Q 2026 Presentation to Investors and Analysts - Transcript

read.thesis: Q3 revenue up 5% to $18.7bn, PBT up 10% ex-notables, but Hong Kong time-deposit mix shift (38% vs 40% peak) squeezes NII margin; all FY26 guidance reiterated with cost growth ~1%, credit ~45bp.

triggers.label: HK time-deposit mix pressure on NII
triggers.quote: we saw increased time deposit margin pressure this quarter

triggers.label: All FY26 guidance reiterated
triggers.quote: We reiterate our full-year Banking NII guidance of at least $46 billion.

triggers.label: Simplification saves $1.9bn of $2bn
triggers.quote: taking us to $1.9 billion of the $2 billion we set out at the half -year

triggers.label: Basel 3.1 CET1 benefit 40-50bp
triggers.quote: Based on our latest modelling, this benefit should be 40 to 50 basis points.

guidance.quote: We reiterate our full-year Banking NII guidance of at least $46 billion.
We are on track to achieve our target of 1% cost growth in 2026 compared to 2025 on a target basis
We maintain our full-year 2026 credit guidance of around 45 basis points.
taking us to $1.9 billion of the $2 billion we set out at the half -year
Return on tangible equity of 17% or better, excluding notable items each year.
revenue rising to 5% year-on-year growth by 2028, excluding notable items.
